title: Zebra in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='31' y='74' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8e8f5'/>

  <rect x='34' y='38' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#4a4a80'/>
  <rect x='40' y='37' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#4a4a80'/>

  <path d='M26 44 L46 40 L46 56 L30 58 Z' fill='#e8e8f5'/>

  <ellipse cx='30' cy='32' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e8e8f5'/>

  <path d='M74 62 Q84 58 82 48' stroke='#4a4a80' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
